latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate and export short videos from images or clips, free, with no editing software required.

- Upload images (JPG, PNG) or clips (MP4, MOV) up to 500MB and describe your desired video.
- Automatically connects to a cloud backend and manages authentication with free, temporary tokens.
- Produces 1080p MP4 video output in 30–60 seconds, optimized for content creators and small business owners.
- Supports timeline edits, background music, text overlays, and batch processing.
- Handles credits, exports, and error states automatically; communicates directly in chat.
